# Universal Bookmarks

> Universal Bookmarks is an open source, self-hostable bookmark manager for saving links, notes, images, and PDFs. It supports archival, full-text and semantic search, rules, and optional AI tagging and summaries.

For AI agents and automation, use the tools below.

## Command line tool

Use the Universal Bookmarks CLI to manage bookmarks, lists, tags, and imports from the terminal.

- [CLI documentation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/integrations/command-line)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@universalbookmarks/cli)
- [Source code](https://github.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/tree/main/apps/cli)

## MCP server

Connect Universal Bookmarks to Claude Desktop and other MCP clients.

- [MCP documentation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/integrations/mcp)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@universalbookmarks/mcp)
- [Source code](https://github.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/tree/main/apps/mcp)

## Skills

Teach compatible agents how to search, save, and organize content in Universal Bookmarks.

- [Agent skills documentation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/integrations/agentic-skills)
- [Universal Bookmarks skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/refs/heads/main/skills/SKILL.md)
- [skills.sh](https://skills.sh/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/universalbookmarks)
- [ClawHub](https://clawhub.ai/universalbookmarks/universalbookmarks-app)

## REST API

Use the authenticated HTTP API to manage bookmarks, lists, tags, highlights, assets, and backups.

- [API documentation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/api/universalbookmarks-api)
- [OpenAPI spec (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/refs/heads/main/packages/open-api/universalbookmarks-openapi-spec.json)

## TypeScript SDK

The official TypeScript client for the Universal Bookmarks API.

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@universalbookmarks/sdk)
- [Repository](https://github.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/tree/main/packages/sdk)

## Self-hosting

Run Universal Bookmarks on your own infrastructure using Docker, Kubernetes, or a supported community package.

- [Docker installation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/installation/docker)
- [Kubernetes installation](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/installation/kubernetes)
- [Environment variables](https://docs.universalbookmarks.com/configuration/environment-variables)
- [Releases](https://github.com/universalbookmarks-app/universalbookmarks/releases)

## Cloud and pricing

Use the managed Universal Bookmarks service without running your own server.

- [Universal Bookmarks Cloud](https://cloud.universalbookmarks.com)

Save and read content through the mobile apps, browser extensions, and community integrations.
